title: Exact Stored Instance and Round
statement: For every finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $C,e,c,A,d,i$, and Boolean word $x$, the stored instance in the packed word with cursor $i$ is exactly $x$, and its stored last-round index equals the last-round index computed from $|x|$, the number of work tapes of $M$, and the producer horizon at input length $|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine
replaced: For every source machine, parameters, instance $x$, and cursor $i$, the retained instance of the persistent body word is $x$ itself, and the stored last-round index equals the last round of the schedule at input length $|x|$, tape count, and producer horizon.
